Medical History

- Current health issues and chronic disease risk factors (e.g., hypertension, diabetes):
  • Acute chest discomfort with left arm and shoulder radiation, diaphoresis, nausea, shortness of breath – concern for acute coronary syndrome  
  • Known hypertension  
  • Smoking (10 cigarettes/day for 15 years)  
  • Overweight and sedentary lifestyle  
  • Alcohol intake ~7–8 pints of beer per week  
  • No known diabetes; cholesterol never checked

- Family history of chronic conditions (e.g., CVD, diabetes):
  • Father died of myocardial infarction at ~60 years  
  • Mother with unspecified heart problems

- Current medications including OTC and traditional medicines:
  • None documented

- Immunisation status reviewed (flu, COVID-19, pneumococcal, shingles, tetanus):
  • Not recorded

- Sexual/reproductive health status and risks:
  • Not recorded

- Lifestyle: physical activity, diet, tobacco, alcohol, substance use:
  • Physical activity: minimal; “generally don't do much activity”  
  • Diet: not discussed  
  • Tobacco: 10 cigarettes/day for 15 years  
  • Alcohol: ~7–8 pints beer/week  
  • Other substances: not recorded

- Hearing and vision concerns:
  • Not recorded

- Mood, mental health, and risk assessment (depression, anxiety, self-harm):
  • Reports feeling “stressed” during episode; no further assessment documented

- Social context: family support, caregiving, housing, financial stressors:
  • Lives alone; no one else in house  
  • Works as restaurant owner (sushi shop)  
  • Front door left open for ambulance access

Examination

- Vital signs: BP, pulse rate and rhythm:
  • Not recorded

- Anthropometry: height, weight, BMI, waist circumference if indicated:
  • Overweight (exact values not documented)

- Oral health: gums, teeth, dentures if relevant:
  • Not recorded

- Ear exam including otoscopy:
  • Not recorded

- Eye exam: visual acuity, pupil response, fundus if indicated:
  • Not recorded

- Urinalysis: dipstick for protein, glucose, ketones, blood:
  • Not recorded

Investigations (as indicated)

- ECG ordered via ambulance on arrival to patient’s home  
- Further investigations (cardiac enzymes, blood tests, imaging) to be performed in hospital as per ACS protocol  
- Other routine screening tests: not discussed or scheduled

Health Promotion & Planning

- Education on chronic disease prevention and lifestyle modification
  • Briefly advised on urgency of cardiac assessment; further counseling pending stabilization

- Discuss patient health goals and priorities
  • Deferred due to acute presentation

- Assess eligibility for GP Management Plan (GPMP) or Team Care Arrangements (TCA)
  • To be considered after hospital discharge for cardiovascular risk management

- Referral to allied health, Quitline, AOD services, Aboriginal health worker, or social supports
  • Smoking cessation support (e.g., Quitline) to be offered post-hospitalization  
  • Cardiovascular rehabilitation program referral likely required

- Schedule follow-up and recall appointments as needed
  • Arrange GP review post-hospital discharge for comprehensive Indigenous Health Assessment and chronic disease management

Consider

- Mental health support or counselling referral (post-event stress/anxiety)  
- Specialist referral for complex chronic disease management (cardiology)  
- Dietitian and exercise physiologist for weight and risk factor modification  
- Social work referral if prolonged hospitalization affects business or living alone  
- Dental, optometry, audiometry referrals once acute issue resolved

Quality checks (always include at bottom of note):

● Missing but clinically expected elements: vital signs, BMI, immunisation history, physical examination findings, routine chronic disease screening (blood pressure reading, lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c, renal/liver function tests), lifestyle counseling detail.  
● Internal conflicts or contradictions: none noted.  
● Transcript quality notes: dialogue clear; limited to acute telehealth encounter prior to ambulance arrival; therefore many standard assessment domains not addressed.
